title: FeatureRegistry
description: Spec-ahead (ADR 0008). Catalog of feature modules, plans and limits, bundled in the app so resolution works offline. Instance: registries/feature-modules.yaml. Resolution, in order: the build supports the module, Remote Config has not switched it off, the plan grants its entitlement (or an active trial, or a Plus pick), and the user has not hidden it; a module with a disabled dependency is disabled. No code anchor yet; moves to schemas/ once implemented.

entitlementKey.description: standard: every plan; automation: paid on-device module (Plus picks, all on Pro and Family); cloud: Pro and Family only

dependencies.description: Modules that must be enabled for this one to be enabled

costClass.description: onDevice: runs in the app with only standard Firestore storage; cloud: needs paid server compute (Blaze)

userHideable.description: The user may hide the module in settings

trialable.description: One 14-day trial per user, no card, user-started

remoteConfigKey.description: Remote Config boolean parameter: kill switch and rollout gate; the bundled default is true

revenueCatEntitlement.description: RevenueCat entitlement identifier that grants the plan; null for free

automationPicks.description: automation modules the user picks when automation is not granted in full; swappable once per billing period

sharedInventories.description: Inventories the user may share outside a household; null = not limited

sharePartners.description: People a shared inventory may be shared with outside a household; null = not limited

maxMembers.description: Household members including the subscriber; 1 = no household

minorsAllowed.description: An adult may invite members aged 13 to 17
